scope: Independent preparatory reference for V888-BOOL-0.3; does not complete parent 0.2 or qualify topology attribution
source_data: synthetic graphs only; no BANC files accessed
tick_rule: At tick t read spikes at t-delay; t<delay reads zero; all nodes commit simultaneously

models.lif: v_next = leak*v + sum(integer_weight*delayed_spike) + current_drive; fire if >= threshold; reset zero; refractory discards incoming drive
models.integer: v_next = clip(trunc_toward_zero(v/divisor) + exact_signed_sum + drive, -cap, cap); threshold/reset/refractory as declared
models.boolean_affine: external_bit XOR parity(all incoming delayed bits); unit weights only
models.boolean_nonlinear: affine output XOR AND(first,second incoming delayed bits); first/second ordered by source index; unit weights only

population_bounds.payload_limit: caller-declared direct vector bytes including ring and scratch
population_bounds.work: caller-declared max ticks and complete edge visits; reject before state commit

independent_oracle: Python arbitrary-precision signed sums; target-gather complete-history implementation independent of Rust source-scatter ring

acceptance.repeat: byte-identical complete traces on the same host/code/toolchain
acceptance.negative_inputs: reject malformed topology/configuration/budget/records; no false success

reset: clear activity, pending delay history and episode counters; retain immutable model parameters and connectivity; no learning is implemented
next: qualify graph/port/control diagnostics and a reviewed V888 integration; add game protocol adapter and separate learned-state persistence without label/history leakage
